title: Conormal module of an extended ideal under flat base change
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, and let $J=IB\subseteq B$ be the ideal generated by its image. Then the canonical $B$-linear map $(I/I^2)\otimes_A B\to J/J^2$, sending $(x\bmod I^2)\otimes b$ to the image of $x$ times $b\bmod J^2$, is surjective; if $B$ is flat as an $A$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], it is an isomorphism.

source.place: Morphisms, Lemma 0473 (morphisms-lemma-conormal-functorial-flat), affine calculation in the proof
